title: Better company before better thinking
subtitle: A short return when the mind needs a different atmosphere
description: A brief path for the hour when private thinking has gone stale and the heart needs sangat to remember what it is for.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Human life answers its chance through Naam and sangat, not isolated effort alone.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Change the company around the thought before demanding the thought change by itself.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle gives the mind a cleaner atmosphere before it tries to solve itself.
evidence.turn: Sangat becomes the practical medicine for a heart stuck in its own air.
evidence.practicalImplication: Move toward one person, place, or practice that makes remembrance more likely.
